fixes.issues: The two riders work. Ponnan has curly hair, a moustache, the red shoulder cloth, a short jacket and a spear, and he turns toward Nagoji. Nagoji, on Kayal, has the topknot, grey temples, clean chin and silver chain. But the rest of the valley contradicts 6.1 and 6.2 and the raja's bible line. (1) A bearded, turbaned chief in a white jama and gold sash sits on a dais in the centre of the road, where the raja's stool stood. He reads as the Kollamkara Raja, but the raja is bare-chested and bare-headed and has no beard elsewhere. (2) The lining troops wear white tunics with yellow sashes, crossed belts and white turbans under bright yellow banners. In 6.1 and 6.2 they are bare-chested men in indigo with plain green banners, and the crossed belts make them read as Travancore regulars. (3) Nagoji's RIGHT wrist has a pinkish scar band. (4) Ponnan's horse is as big as Kayal, though it should be a head lower. (5) The spear points do not crowd close to the riders as the script asks.

fixes.correction: Keep the high ridge viewpoint, the thick black columns of smoke over the torched pepper gardens and support poles, the canal and the wide hazy sky. Remove every fallen or lying man: there are no bodies and no dead or wounded figures anywhere in this panel. The two dead men appear only in the next panel, inside the gardens. Keep the upper band of grey haze above the smoke clear and low-detail for three captions.
fixes.issues: The core view is good: thick black smoke columns over torched pepper gardens along a canal, seen from a high ridge, with a clear grey haze for the captions. But two dead men lie in the foreground on the rocky ridge. The script has no bodies in 6.4. In 6.5 the same two men lie in the burned gardens, being covered with a cloth, so the dead appear twice in two different places and the 6.5 reveal is spent early. The raiders are not far below either: they walk a path on the near slope at the viewer's level. Several wear red head bands and one a red waist cloth, and the fallen men wear red waist cloths too, though red belongs to Ponnan alone in this chapter.

fixes.correction: This panel is the chase BEFORE the ambush. Keep the narrow track between red rock outcrops, the shallow stream over mossy stones and the hooves throwing spray. They duck their heads and raise their forearms as low branches whip across their faces. fixes.issues: v01 shows the ambush that belongs to 7.2: bare-chested matchlock men and archers are already firing from both banks, with a muzzle flash and powder smoke, and the camera sits behind the shooters. fixes.correction: Keep this composition exactly: Kayal head-on filling the frame through the stream spray, Nagoji with his talwar swung out to frame left, and the wide-eyed shooter at lower right who has dropped his smoking matchlock and grabs his sword hilt. The riders following behind him must not resemble him: they wear white head cloths wrapped over the whole head (no topknots, no grey at the temples), plain white shoulder cloths with no gold stripes, and short beards or no moustache. fixes.issues: Nagoji is drawn twice. The bible's brand is a pale puckered patch of raised scar on the INNER forearm, never a dark design. fixes.correction: Keep this two-shot: Nagoji on Kayal at left, Ponnan breathing hard on his sweat-streaked horse at right, Travancore riders in white regrouping behind, the stream and the fallen raider at lower right, and the open sky band across the top for three balloons. fixes.correction: Keep Padmini exactly as drawn: grey-threaded black hair coiled low at the nape, gold ball earrings and gold bead necklace, cream silk sari with a narrow gold border in the old Kerala drape with no blouse, long wooden walking stick in her right hand, flinty sideways look. fixes.issues: Padmini herself is good: grey-threaded black hair coiled low, gold earrings and bead necklace, cream sari with gold border in the old drape, walking stick, flinty look, at the near end of the column. The problem is the mid-ground rider just ahead of her. He has long curly black hair, a moustache, a rust-red turban and a red waist sash, and rides a bay with a black mane. That is Nagoji's old commander look (ch11 to ch21). This panel's third line is NAGOJI (off), so readers will take this rider for Nagoji speaking, in a costume the ch23 lock forbids (no turban, no sash). fixes.correction: Keep Nagoji exactly as drawn, standing beside the gun with one hand on his hip: topknot, grey at the temples, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, small gold ear stud, silver chain, cream shoulder cloth, white mundu. Keep the sweating bare-chested crew in white head cloths hauling the carriage on ropes, the rocky ridge, the thorn valley and the late-afternoon sky. Fix the gun and the gun captain. The gun is a plain 1740s muzzle-loading bronze or iron field gun on a two-wheeled wooden carriage: smooth barrel, a rounded cascabel knob at the rear, a touch-hole on top, no breech block, no box or mechanism at the rear and no sight of any kind. The gun captain crouches behind the breech and sights with his naked eye along the top of the bare barrel toward the thickest scrub, one eye closed, one hand on the carriage trail or the wooden elevating wedge. fixes.issues: Anachronism in the key action. The gun captain presses his eye to a telescopic sight, a scope with an eyepiece, mounted on a boxy breech block, and holds it like binoculars. Gunners of the 1740s sighted by eye along a plain muzzle-loading barrel. Everything else works: Nagoji matches (topknot, grey temples, curled moustache, clean chin, gold ear stud, silver chain, cream shoulder cloth, white mundu, beside the gun), the bare-chested crew in white head cloths haul on ropes, and the ridge, sky and lettering space are good.

fixes.correction: Keep the composition: the wide view from behind and beside the gun on the rocky ridge, the bright muzzle flame, the great bank of white smoke rolling out over the thorn valley, the burst of dark birds exploding out of the trees across the valley, and the open late-afternoon sky above. Change the gun crew to match the previous panel: sweating bare-chested men in white mundu with plain white cotton head cloths, no waistcoats, no long shirts, no turbans. fixes.issues: The beat itself is good: wide view, muzzle flame, a great bank of smoke, birds bursting from the trees, open sky for the caption. The gun crew is the problem. Every man wears a rust-red or orange turban, a red waist sash, a brown waistcoat and a long shirt. The large kneeling man in the foreground wears exactly Nagoji's old commander colours (rust-red turban with a red sash). fixes.correction: Keep this exact composition, lighting and figure: Nagoji crouched in the thorn, head turned toward the shot, topknot tied high on the crown with grey at the temples, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, small gold ear stud, silver chain, cream gold-bordered shoulder cloth over the LEFT shoulder, white mundu, his hand braced on the rock, the matchlock ball shredding the leaves beside his ear and the gunman half-hidden behind a boulder in the smoke. fixes.issues: v01 is strong on almost everything: Nagoji matches the sheet and the ch23 row (Kerala topknot tied high, grey at the temples, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, small gold ear stud, silver chain, cream gold-bordered shoulder cloth, white mundu), thorns catch at the cloth, and the matchlock ball tears the leaves beside his ear with the gunman visible behind. fixes.correction: Nagoji must match 9.1 exactly: Kerala topknot tied high on the crown, first grey at the temples, the hair at the sides pulled up rather than hanging loose, bare-chested under a cream gold-bordered shoulder cloth worn over the LEFT shoulder, white mundu with NO red or coloured waistband or sash, silver chain of office on his bare chest, small gold ear stud, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin. fixes.issues: v01 fails the character lock. Nagoji has loose shoulder-length curly hair with no topknot and no grey at the temples. fixes.correction: Make both foreground figures true dark silhouettes, near-black and flat, set against a bright, pale, glowing wall of grey-white powder smoke that fills the background. His silhouette profile must clearly show the Kerala topknot tied high on the crown (no loose hair hanging to the shoulders), the thick curled moustache, a clean-shaven chin, the shoulder cloth and the mundu. fixes.issues: v01 fails the character lock and the staging. Nagoji has loose curly hair with no topknot, no grey at the temples and no silver chain. Nagoji stands a stride away with his sword held low behind him, not stepping inside the raised swing. The background dagger man slipping on loose stones and the ash-smeared raider face did work and should be kept.

fixes.correction: Keep the boy exactly as drawn: thin and beardless, about sixteen, hair in a small knot, torn brown shoulder cloth, a torn white mundu, crouched with his back pressed against the pale rock face, both empty hands raised palms-out, eyes wide with terror looking up toward the viewer. Show NO other people in the frame, living or dead: no raiders, no soldiers, no partial figures at the edges, and no guns, spears or swords pointing at him. The threat is the viewer's position: the camera is at the eye level of an unseen man standing over him, looking slightly down. At most, the edge of one dark standing shadow falls across the stones at his feet from the bottom of the frame. Same thorn scrub, rocks and late-afternoon smoke-hazed light as the rest of the page. Leave the plain rock face above and to the right of his head clear and low in detail for a speech balloon.
fixes.issues: The boy himself is right: thin, beardless, about sixteen or younger, small hair knot, torn brown shoulder cloth, pressed against a rock face, empty hands raised open with sound fingers, terrified eyes. The panel fails on who is present and on period. Three extra armed men surround him: a gunman, a spearman and a swordsman with cross-belts at the right edge. The script stages the boy alone, cornered by Nagoji off-panel, and page 10 has only Nagoji and Ponnan with him. The right swordsman could be misread as Nagoji in the wrong costume. The left man's gun is also anachronistic: a later rifle with steel barrel bands, a sling swivel, a trigger guard and a capped muzzle, not a 1740s Indian matchlock.

fixes.correction: Show Nagoji STANDING, chest-up and close, leaning slightly forward toward the cornered boy off-panel, his right fist gripping the talwar hilt at the bottom edge of the frame, the blade out of frame. Keep exactly what worked: Kerala topknot high on the crown, first grey at the temples, small gold ear stud, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, silver chain of office, bare soot-streaked chest, white mundu with cream shoulder cloth, thorn branches and drifting powder smoke against pale cliffs. Make the laugh uglier: head tipped back, teeth bared, eyes narrowed and cruel, not cheerful. Keep his LEFT forearm out of frame or turned away so no brand shows. If any brand is visible, it is only a pale puckered patch of raised ridges, never a dark ring, emblem, glyph or letter. No other living person in the frame, only the still bodies lying in soft focus behind him. Leave the upper right sky and smoke clear for a caption and a speech balloon.
fixes.issues: v01 gets Nagoji's face right: topknot, grey temples, gold stud, curled moustache, clean chin, silver chain, soot, white mundu and cream shoulder cloth, teeth bared. But the old brand on his forearm (centre right) is painted as a dark stamped circle with a glyph inside. That reads as an emblem or pseudo-letter, not the bible's pale puckered patch of ridges. fixes.correction: Keep the low angle from behind the boy's head and shoulders, the talwar raised high two-handed against a white sky, and the thorn, rocks and smoke. Redraw Nagoji in his chapter 23 look, matching 10.1: Kerala topknot high on the crown, first grey at the temples, small gold ear stud, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, silver chain of office on a BARE soot-streaked chest, white mundu with a cream shoulder cloth over one shoulder. NO tunic, NO sleeves, NO waist sash of any colour, NO scabbard. His face is twisted in an ugly, eager snarl. The boy in the foreground is thin and beardless, about sixteen, hair in a small knot, a torn brown shoulder cloth, shrinking down with his empty hands raised. Keep the upper sky clear for the caption.
fixes.issues: The framing works: low angle from behind the boy, talwar raised two-handed against a white sky, thorn and rock, open sky for the caption. But Nagoji is off-model for chapter 23. He has no topknot (long loose hair), no grey at the temples and no silver chain, and he wears a long-sleeved cream tunic with a brown-red waist sash and a scabbard, not the bare-chested white mundu and cream shoulder cloth of 10.1 and 10.4. His face is calm, not the ugly bloodlust of the beat. The boy has shaggy loose hair and a torn tunic, not the small hair knot and torn brown shoulder cloth he has in 9.5.

fixes.correction: Make this a TIGHT INSERT, on foot, with no horses and no faces. From the RIGHT edge of the frame, Ponnan's hand clamps hard around Nagoji's wrist just above the hilt, knuckles tight. Only Ponnan's forearm shows, with the edge of his short deep-red jacket sleeve with gold trim and a fold of red shoulder cloth at the frame edge. No tunic sleeve on Nagoji. fixes.issues: This is not the tight arm-only insert the script calls for. It is a wide two-shot with both faces drawn, and both men are mounted on horses, though the fight in the thorn is on foot. fixes.correction: Keep the composition, the thorn setting, Nagoji's chapter 23 look and Ponnan's soot-streaked face and grip. fixes.issues: Both men are on-model. Nagoji has topknot, grey, gold stud, curled moustache, clean chin, silver chain and white mundu with shoulder cloth. fixes.correction: Make this a CLOSE shot on Ponnan, chest-up, filling the left two-thirds of the frame. He stands upright, face streaked with soot, eyes clear and hard, mouth open mid-word. Nagoji stands at the right edge, partly cropped, NOT seated: topknot, grey at the temples, small gold ear stud, curled moustache, clean chin, the silver chain of office on his bare soot-streaked chest, cream shoulder cloth over a white mundu. Background: thorn and pale powder smoke only, with no other living figures. Keep the upper area of smoke and sky clear for two speech balloons.
fixes.issues: Ponnan is on-model (curly hair, moustache, clean chin, red jacket and shoulder cloth) and grips Nagoji's wrist with his mouth open. fixes.correction: Nagoji must wear the chapter 23 Ananthan Pillai look exactly as in panels 11.1 and 11.4: his long curly black hair gathered into a Kerala topknot high on the crown (never loose on the shoulders, no turban), first grey at the temples, one small gold ear stud in each visible ear (no dangling rings), thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, the silver chain of office on his bare chest, white mundu with the cream shoulder cloth, no sash. fixes.issues: Nagoji does not have the chapter 23 look. His long curly hair hangs loose with no Kerala topknot and no grey at the temples. fixes.issues: Nagoji is in the wrong costume, so he does not match the chapter 23 row or panels 11.1 and 11.4. fixes.correction: Varma must be the only person in the frame.
